purpose: Analytical check of draft transfer-air arithmetic using the version 2 ASHRAE thermodynamic psychrometric method; not engineering approval or flow-network validation.

source.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals (2025), Chapter 1: Psychrometrics, Equations 5, 21, 26, 30 and 33
source.supports: IAPWS-IF97 saturation pressure, thermodynamic wet-bulb humidity ratio, moist-air enthalpy, specific volume, and psychrometric energy relationships. It does not establish the project's transfer-flow reference assumption.

case.equation: IAPWS saturation pressure pws, W from ASHRAE Eq. 33; h=1.006T+W(2501+1.86T); v=0.287055(T+273.15)(1+1.607W)/P; mdot=Vdot_source/v_source; Qs=mdot*1.006(Tsource-Ttarget); Qt=mdot(hsource-htarget); Ql=Qt-Qs.
assumptions: 50 L/s is explicitly referenced to sending-room air state.
Both wet-bulb values are thermodynamic and above freezing.
Expected values were independently calculated from the cited equations and rounded to the production output precision.
exclusions: Project-specific confirmation of the sending-room flow reference
